record.original_question: For small numbers of point vortices, can one systematically study their motion and bifurcations on manifolds such as half-planes, quarter-planes, hemispheres, quarter-spheres, disks, tori, cylinders, and half-cylinders?

artifact.status_search_result: There is an active body of work on point-vortex dynamics for small N on several of the listed domains: relative equilibria and their bifurcations on the sphere (including hemisphere via reflection) have been studied (Pekarsky–Marsden, Laurent-Polz, Montaldi and collaborators), the 2-vortex problem on a torus is known to be integrable, and stability of latitudinal rings on tori has been analyzed (Sakajo and others). Partial results also exist for the disk and half-plane via image methods. However, a unified systematic treatment of bifurcations across all of the listed geometries (half-plane, quarter-plane, hemisphere, quarter-sphere, disk, torus, cylinder, half-cylinder) does not appear to have been completed.

status_evidence.title: Point vortex interactions on a toroidal surface
status_evidence.snippet: 2-vortex problem is integrable on a torus; analysis of small-N configurations on tori.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results known on the torus for small N.

status_evidence.title: Toroidal Geometry Stabilizing a Latitudinal Ring of Point Vortices on a Torus
status_evidence.snippet: For low aspect ratio on a torus, N=7 is a critical number for the stability of the N-ring.
status_evidence.claim: Stability/bifurcation studies for rings on tori exist.

status_evidence.title: Point Vortices on the Sphere: Stability of Symmetric Relative Equilibria
status_evidence.snippet: Bifurcation diagrams for systems of 3–6 identical vortices on the sphere.
status_evidence.claim: Bifurcations of small-N vortex configurations on the sphere are partially understood.

status_evidence.title: Relative equilibria of point vortices on the sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Global existence theorems and local bifurcation results for relative equilibria on the sphere.
status_evidence.claim: Sphere case has substantial known results.
